text:
Aisha: FYI we got an inquiry from VectorLabs about listing their 'Zephyr-XL' model. they want the model available both as an inference image and downloadable weights for enterprise customers.
Tom: do we have precedent for downloadable vendor-hosted weights? I thought we only allowed hosting of quantized variants.
Lena: precedent is mixed. partners sometimes negotiate a restricted redistribution clause + CLA. legal needs ECCN + provenance. cc @Ethan
Ethan: will need to see their third-party license list and any dataset vendor contracts. also ask for a short training-data summary.
Aisha: VectorLabs says their dataset is internal curations + public corpora, but no detailed manifest attached. they also included a short license snippet: `"allow customers to redistribute internally and to sublicense to end-customers"`.
Tom: that language is pretty broad. does our marketplace policy allow sublicensing?
Lena: we generally avoid sublicensing unless it's very restricted (enterprise-only, no reissue). request an amendment: attribution + no sublicensing to third parties.
legal-bot: reminder: attach partner license and training-data-summary to PART-901 before next review: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-901
Ethan: export control flags: need country of origin for model artifacts + any non-US contributors. If any contributor is in restricted jurisdictions, it complicates hosting raw checkpoints.
Aisha: VectorLabs is US-based but used contractors in other regions. I'll ask for contributor locations.
Tom: ops follow-up: if we permit downloads, we should force signed agreements and short-lived presigned URLs + separate billing for transfers. Otherwise bandwidth and legal exposure increase.
Lena: agree. also request code of conduct for downstream redistribution and a simple audit log requirement for who downloaded weights.
Aisha: VectorLabs wants joint marketing and co-branded documentation. marketing wants a security/QA attestation before greenlighting co-brand.
Ethan: propose option: accept marketplace listing for inference API + quantized runtime images publicly; allow gated downloads of raw weights only after: (1) signed enterprise agreement; (2) export check cleared; (3) security attestation; (4) S3 isolation.
Tom: sounds right. ops estimate ~4 days to create gated bucket + access workflow once legal signs off.
Lena: I'll draft a short addendum EULA that: attribution required, no sublicensing to third parties, distribution limited to contract-specified customers, and requires an audit log. will share for review by EOD tomorrow.
Aisha: action items: Aisha asks VectorLabs for contributor list, dataset manifest, ECCN/classification, and security attestation. Lena drafts EULA addendum. Ethan compiles export checklist. Tom scopes infra gating. reconvene next Tue.
Aisha: I'll update PART-901 with the requested docs and timeline.
legal-bot: PART-901 updated by Aisha: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-901 :memo: "VectorLabs Zephyr-XL onboarding - docs requested"
